arcs.title: 加班夜
arcs.zh: 加班夜：办公室只剩你们两个
arcs.summary: 深夜的办公室，只剩你和她在赶最后一份文件。灯灭了一半，咖啡凉了，距离也一点点消失了。

scenes.dialogue: "还差最后一份。……你先走吧，我留下来收尾。"
scenes.dialogue_en: "Just one more file. You can head home first — I'll wrap up."

scenes.dialogue: "楼里好像只剩我们了。……你别站那么远。"
scenes.dialogue_en: "I think we're the only ones left in the building. Don't stand so far away."
"You smell like coffee."
"...Just once. Don't let anyone find out."
"The files will get messed up." "Let them."

scenes.dialogue: "……天亮了。明天，还要装作什么都没发生吗？"
scenes.dialogue_en: "...It's dawn. Do we pretend nothing happened tomorrow?"

arcs.title: 温泉旅馆
arcs.zh: 温泉旅馆：一个人的露天汤
arcs.summary: 雪夜的山中旅馆，她包下了露天温泉。雾气、木栅、雪声，和一句「反正没人」。

scenes.dialogue: "这个时间是没人的。……你要一起吗？"
scenes.dialogue_en: "Nobody comes at this hour. ...Are you joining?"
"Don't turn around. ...I said don't turn around."
"...It's hot. Get in."
"Where is your hand going, under the water?"
"Snow... landed on your shoulder."
"The water's cooling. ...Let's stay a little longer."

arcs.title: 放学后的教室
arcs.zh: 放学后的教室：窗帘拉着
arcs.summary: 值日表上只有两个名字。夕阳、粉笔灰、空教室，和一张不该坐上去的课桌。

scenes.dialogue: "今天只有我们两个值日。……你擦黑板，我扫地。"
scenes.dialogue_en: "Only the two of us on duty today. You take the board, I'll sweep."
"Someone outside can see. ...Close the curtain."
"The desk... is cold."
"My tie is too tight. ...Help me?"
"The closing bell... rang a long time ago."
"Shh — someone's coming. ...Don't make a sound."

arcs.title: 雨夜酒店
arcs.summary: 暴雨、满房、一张大床。她说「我睡沙发」，然后谁都没去睡。

scenes.dialogue_en: "...I'm soaked through. Turn around."
"There's only one towel. ...Wait your turn."
"I'll take the sofa. ...Don't laugh."
"...You breathe too loudly."
"...The rain seems lighter." "Mm."

scenes.dialogue: "雨停了。……今天的事，就当是被雨困住的。"
scenes.dialogue_en: "The rain stopped. ...Let's blame today on the rain."

arcs.title: 公会之夜
arcs.summary: 讨伐结束，酒馆打烊，只剩两张床的旅店房间和一身没洗掉的伤。

scenes.dialogue_en: "It's just a scratch... hey, don't look."

scenes.dialogue: "赢了就该喝一杯！……你怎么不喝？"
scenes.dialogue_en: "We won, so we drink! ...Why aren't you drinking?"
"The fire... is a little too warm."
"The armor... is stuck. Come help."
"The next room... can hear us." "Then be quiet."
"Next quest... together again?"

arcs.title: 下播之后
arcs.zh: 下播之后：麦克风忘了关
arcs.summary: 直播结束，她摘下耳机才发现麦克风还亮着 —— 而你已经进门了。

scenes.dialogue_en: "—And that's the stream. Thanks for today, everyone."
"...Wait. This light is still on?"
"When did you come in?!"
"The cable... is tangled. Don't move."
"...It's still recording." "Then let it."
"...Now I'm really offline."

arcs.title: 夜晚的海
arcs.summary: 夏天最后一个夜晚，沙滩上只剩篝火、海浪和一件没穿的防晒衫。

scenes.dialogue_en: "Summer... ends tomorrow."
"It's wet and uncomfortable. ...Don't look."
"The water's still warm. Come here."
"A wave's coming — hold on to me."
"Sand will get in my hair." "Then let it."
"...Can summer come again?"

arcs.title: 训练场之后
arcs.summary: 对练结束，盔甲卸了一半，训练场只剩你们两个人和一桶凉水。

scenes.dialogue_en: "Again. I won't hold back this time."
"The inside of the armor... is all sweat."
"...Do you want some too?"
"This buckle... I can't undo it myself."
"Someone might walk by..." "Not at this hour."
"...Tomorrow's drill, you're losing."

arcs.title: 青梅竹马
arcs.zh: 青梅竹马：十年前的那个约定
arcs.summary: 搬家回来，隔壁还是那户人家。她翻出相册说「你记得吗」——十年前的约定，她一直记着。

scenes.dialogue: 「欢迎回来。……十年了，你长这么高了。」
scenes.dialogue_en: Welcome back. ...Ten years, and you got so tall.

scenes.dialogue: 「你看这张——小时候你哭得超难看。」
scenes.dialogue_en: Look at this one. You cried so ugly back then.

scenes.dialogue: 「你说过，长大以后要娶我的。……记得吗？」
scenes.dialogue_en: You said you'd marry me when we grew up. ...Remember?
We walked this road every day when we were kids.
So... does it still count now?

scenes.dialogue: 「明天，我还要叫你名字。就像小时候那样。」
scenes.dialogue_en: Tomorrow I'll still call your name. Just like when we were kids.

arcs.title: 催眠怀表
arcs.zh: 催眠怀表：她自己想知道答案
arcs.summary: 她在旧货店淘到一块怀表，说是能让人说真话。她坚持要试，而且要你来做那个提问的人。

scenes.dialogue: 「店主说，这块表能让人说真话。」
scenes.dialogue_en: The shopkeeper said this watch makes people tell the truth.
You swing it, I'll watch. ...Don't stop.
...Ask me. I'll tell the truth today.

scenes.dialogue: 「……我喜欢你。这句话我憋了三年。」
scenes.dialogue_en: ...I like you. I've held that in for three years.

scenes.dialogue: 「表……停了。不过我好像不需要它了。」
scenes.dialogue_en: The watch... stopped. But I don't think I need it anymore.

scenes.dialogue: 「现在我是清醒的。……再说一次：我喜欢你。」
scenes.dialogue_en: I'm awake now. ...I'll say it again: I like you.

arcs.title: 时间停止
arcs.zh: 时间停止：她掏出了那块表
arcs.summary: 她说自己捡到一块能停住时间的表，然后当着你的面按了下去。世界安静下来，只有你们两个还能动。

scenes.dialogue: 「别问哪来的。你只要看着我按下去。」
scenes.dialogue_en: Don't ask where I got it. Just watch me press it.
—Three, two, one.

scenes.dialogue: 「你看，雨停在半空。……现在只有我们两个能动了。」
scenes.dialogue_en: Look, the rain stopped mid-air. ...Now only the two of us can move.
Nobody can see us anyway. We can go anywhere.
There are nine minutes left on it. ...Is that enough?

scenes.dialogue: 「时间回来了。……刚才那九分钟，我们都记得，对吧？」
scenes.dialogue_en: Time is back. ...We both remember those nine minutes, right?
